transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this certification meeting. Before I sign off on the administration plan for tomorrow's morning testing session, I need to hear from each of you about any operational requirements or concerns. We have 27 students scheduled to take the online state assessment, and the draft plan currently has them in the library using student-owned laptops with two proctors and the standard health-monitoring procedure. Room 204 is also available if needed. Let's start with the technology coordinator — are there any tech requirements or issues we should be aware of?

The fire-safety inspection record for the library, which I reviewed this week, limits it to 18 students during a testing session because two exits must remain clear. With 27 students scheduled, we cannot safely or legally accommodate all of them in the library alone. The certified plan must use both the library and Room 204 to stay within the occupancy limit. I have not yet updated the room plan to reflect this, but this needs to be addressed before Dr. Lee signs off.
